name: Camping Viktoria
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

Camping Viktoria is located in Wald im Pinzgau in the Tirol, nestled in the scenic Kitzbüheler Alps. This family-run campsite offers a peaceful setting, surrounded by lush forests and alpine meadows. In summer, the nearby mountains provide perfect starting points for hiking and mountain biking adventures. In winter, guests can easily access the nearby Resterhöhe ski resort within the KitzSki network. The site includes facilities such as sanitary buildings, power outlets, and waste disposal stations, ensuring a hassle-free stay for active outdoor enthusiasts in the Alps.
